note: Starter lines by batter hand and by home or away, keyed by MLB person id. OPS+ is 100 x league OPS allowed / this line's OPS allowed, so 100 is league average and higher is better. xFIP is null because the source column is empty for every one of the 5,027 source rows - a pipeline gap, not a filter here. OPS is published for the handedness splits only, because the source repeats the season figure in the home and away rows rather than splitting it.
